evidence: SC-F03 one selected employee identifies edit/export target; new does not require selection
SC-F04 list reflection explicitly DB-unsaved, whole employee/all careers saved atomically; SC-F06 one-code save kept distinct
Five business Forms and six functions preserved; F05 stays F03 export state plus standard save dialog
WINFORMS/ACCESS classic native controls; Yu Gothic UI 11pt roles and existing per-field Twips widths preserved
Titles, parent employee identity and mode separated from tabs; new nine labels have no new business DB columns
Current target, disabled operations, processing state and destructive confirmation scope use common contracts
Career list 420px and 80/80/240 columns make ordinary project names legible; 100-character values remain reachable in selected detail
Long values and 1000-character text require full keyboard/text-box access, not truncated storage
Design distinguishes 1366x768 CSS mock from native client/DPI; headings and tabs required visible on normal transitions
Initial tab/focus/origin and lower-edge save/cancel/reopen paths explicitly paired; list internal retained position separate
F03 cancel restores four raw values, search state, applied-condition existence, original results/selection/list position with zero searches
F04 tab route follows list/actions/detail/reflection/global save; readonly employee/code/reference fields remain keyboard reachable
Unreflected edits, discard cancellation, failed saves and unknown outcome preserve input or block unsafe resave according to existing messages

confirmedConstraints: DEMO admin/ADMIN and staff/STAFF with common 123, raw password 3-128 Unicode scalars, blank initial fields, internal IDs/roles and existing cryptographic adoption unchanged
Single Windows 11 / 64-bit Microsoft 365 Access+Excel ACCDB, standard unbound Forms, ACE tables; no server DB or new business screen
Five tables / 48 columns, no employee delete, fixed three employment values, employee number leading zeros and immutability preserved
200-row full acquisition and internal scrolling / no paging; 0-20 careers / 99 codes design limits and isolated boundary fixtures preserved
Parent and all careers explicit atomic save including current unreflected detail; apply/add/remove update only buffer; concurrency, ownership, known rollback and unknown-commit safeguards preserved

Access save-success return retains its pre-existing raw-condition re-search contract, including previously unsearched creation; it does not inherit Web return semantics; post-save condition/re-display error does not invite a second save

Excel output uses saved coherent snapshot for one employee, two fixed sheets, complete values, A4 portrait / horizontal one page / vertical automatic; no whole-output one-page shrink or claim of tested print settings

surfaceAndChecks.dialogCoverage: Unreflected/reflection/discard, remove/global cancel, standard save/replace, stop/code discard; native OS styling exceptions explicit while text/target/keys/return remain applicable
surfaceAndChecks.downstreamRequirement: Expand parent/page/dialog inventory into separate real targets and applicable/reasoned-excluded individual rules; no cross-category universal rule; design table is not a native measurement
